content:
The implementation failed due to incorrect ARGB color formatting in the Excel template, causing a mismatch in the expected yellow fill color.
The test_template_formatting_preserved failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py at cell H12. The verifier reported 'H12 fill changed: FFFFF2CC', which failed the assertion 'assert FFFFF2CC in {00FFF2CC, FFF2CC}'. While 5 tests passed, the workbook generation logic or template preservation failed to match the specific legacy RGB/ARGB constants required by the verifier.
